subject: Post-call: air-gapped deployment — architecture & maintenance checklist
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Greer <t.greer@edgegen.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: air-gapped deployment — architecture & maintenance checklist

Hi Tom / Sasha —

Thanks for taking time this morning. Per our discovery call, I wanted to capture the outstanding items we agreed to clarify for the on-prem, air-gapped deployment track so your security and ops teams can validate. Short summary + action items below.

Quick context: EdgeGen is evaluating Redwood Private for an air-gapped lab install (no outbound network). Primary concerns are signed offline upgrades, hardware spares/maintenance SLAs, and how Redwood handles offline KV cache migration and model updates in sealed environments.

Outstanding items (please confirm any that are incorrect or missing):
- Hardware inventory: we need a current BOM + NICs/firmware versions and whether any RAID controllers or HBA firmware might require vendor-specific firmware bundles. Attached: edgegen_hw_inventory_template.xlsx (fill and return).
- Offline update process: Do you have an established process for receiving signed update bundles via physical media (USB / DVD) and validating signatures? If so, what tooling is used and who signs the image?
- Remote access constraints: You mentioned no outbound SSH or telemetry. Confirm whether ephemeral management network is allowed for initial provisioning only (on-site laptop -> provisioning switch), or zero network policy is required even during install.
- Maintenance windows & rollback: Typical acceptable maintenance cadence and max allowed downtime per update. Also confirm whether cold-swap spare policy is acceptable versus hot-swap spares onsite.
- Onsite spares & RMA: Who handles spare procurement (EdgeGen vs vendor) and preferred RMA SLA (48h vs 72h)?
- KMS and secrets: Confirm whether customer-managed HSM/KMS will be used for model encryption keys, or Redwood-managed keys in a sealed HSM appliance shipped and stored on-prem.
- Evidence & compliance: Security team requested signed package checksums, a concise MOP for offline upgrades, and sample audit log exports. We can supply sanitized examples but need to confirm format preference (CSV vs syslog archive).

Next steps we propose:
1) You return the filled HW inventory template (attachment) — target: Wed 2028-05-09.
2) Schedule a 60-min ops deep dive with your infrastructure lead + our field engineer (Marissa) — propose Thu 2028-05-10 or Fri 2028-05-11.
3) We’ll circulate a sealed-ops-runbook-template.md that shows our recommended offline upgrade MOP and signature verification steps; you can annotate for your environment.

If anything above is off, flag it and we’ll adjust.

Regards,

Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Email: aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0142

Attachments: edgegen_hw_inventory_template.xlsx, sealed-ops-runbook-template.md, network-zone-diagram.png
From: Tom Greer <t.greer@edgegen.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sasha Lin <sasha.lin@edgegen.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: air-gapped deployment — architecture & maintenance checklist

Aisha —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side:
- We'll populate the inventory template; expect it by EOD Mon (2028-05-07).
- Offline updates: currently we use a signed tarball process. Images are signed by our security team (GPG) and verified locally; we cannot accept any outbound-checking of signatures.
- Management access: initial provisioning can use a temporary management VLAN tied to an onsite laptop — after provisioning that VLAN is decommissioned. No persistent outbound network allowed.
- Spares: EdgeGen prefers to maintain a small pool of cold spares onsite; we handle procurement. RMA SLA 72h is acceptable.
- KMS: We will be using an on-prem HSM cluster (Thales) and can supply public keys for initial key wrapping. Not interested in Redwood-managed keys for this deployment.
- Evidence: CSV audit exports are preferred.

We can do Thu 2028-05-10 at 11:00 PT for the ops deep dive. Please confirm attendees and an invite.

Tom
Tom Greer
Head of Infrastructure, EdgeGen Pharma
+t.greer@edgegen.com
